title: TRICARE Select Corrected Outpatient Line - Payment Computation
content:
**Scope.** The payment on the corrected adjudication of a reversed **TRICARE Select** professional or outpatient line is computed for an enrollee who is the only member of the sponsor family enrolled in Select, read from the enrollee's own Select enrollment carrying the family's fee billing under an individual fee arrangement, whose Select enrollment took effect in the plan year that contains the adjudication date, and who holds no TRICARE Prime enrollment or exactly one that took effect in that same plan year, so that the family's deductible and catastrophic totals are the enrollee's own and every claim line and every installment whose coverage period has begun on that enrollment, and every Prime claim line and Prime installment of the enrollee, belongs to that calendar plan year; for any other enrollee this calculation settles nothing. A fee-exempt enrollment carries no fee arrangement from which the family's Select membership can be read, so the fee-exempt tiers (the TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member tiers) are outside this calculation by design.

## Computation

1. **Amount cost-shared on.** The amount a corrected outpatient line is cost-shared on is the reversed line's allowed amount.
2. **Deductible.** The corrected outpatient line applies to the deductible the smaller of that amount and the tier's individual deductible.
3. **Cost share.** Its cost share is the tier's network outpatient cost-share percentage of the amount left once the deductible is taken off, rounded to the cent.
4. **Liability figured.** The beneficiary liability on the corrected outpatient line is the deductible applied plus the cost share, rounded to the cent.
5. **Cap.** The beneficiary liability is cut to the room left under the tier's family catastrophic cap once the family catastrophic total is taken away, never below zero: that total is the beneficiary liability posted on the enrollment's claim lines less the liability their reversals withdrew, plus, where the tier's enrollment fees count toward the catastrophic cap, the enrollment fees paid for installments whose coverage period has begun (the payments posted, never more than those installments), plus any amount credited from TRICARE Prime as the carryover rule below states.
6. **Carryover from TRICARE Prime.** Where the beneficiary changed from TRICARE Prime to this Select enrollment during the plan year (the Prime enrollment ended by the beneficiary's own choice on the day before Select took effect), the amounts already credited toward the Prime catastrophic cap are credited to the family catastrophic total of a corrected outpatient line. Within this calculation's scope the beneficiary's only Prime enrollment took effect in the plan year, so every Prime record belongs to that calendar plan year, and the Prime amounts are: the cost shares on the beneficiary's Prime claim lines other than point-of-service charges, less the cost shares withdrawn by Prime reversals, plus the Prime enrollment fees paid toward the Prime installments whose coverage period has begun (the Prime payments posted, never more than those installments, payments being applied oldest first). Where those Prime amounts reach the tier's family catastrophic cap, the cap itself is credited; where the beneficiary changed from Prime in that way and they fall short of it, those Prime amounts are credited; otherwise nothing is credited from Prime. Point-of-service charges, premium-based plan costs and amounts a nonparticipating provider bills above the allowed amount never count toward the total.
7. **TRICARE payment.** TRICARE pays as primary payer: the allowed amount less the beneficiary liability, rounded to the cent and never below zero.

Plan years are calendar years of 12 months, reckoned on the calendar from 2000-01-01; an installment's coverage period has begun when it starts on or before the adjudication date, the fee accounts being read back over 600 months.

## Worked figures (hypothetical, TRICARE Select Retiree Group A: individual deductible 150.00, network percentage 20, cap 3000.00, fees count)

| Allowed amount | Deductible | Cost share | Liability figured | Family catastrophic total | Liability carried | TRICARE payment |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 400.00 | 150.00 | 20 percent of 250.00: 50.00 | 200.00 | liability posted 1000.00, fees paid 396.00: 1396.00 | 200.00 | 200.00 |
| 400.00 | 150.00 | 50.00 | 200.00 | liability posted 2500.00, fees paid 396.00: 2896.00 | room 104.00 | 296.00 |
| 400.00 | 150.00 | 50.00 | 200.00 | liability posted 1800.00, fees paid 396.00, Prime credit 850.00: 3046.00 | 0.00 | 400.00 |

In the third row the Prime credit of 850.00 is hypothetical: Prime cost shares of 700.00 other than point-of-service charges, less 150.00 withdrawn by a Prime reversal, plus 300.00 of Prime fees paid toward begun installments.
